D01 / WATERConcept · Field validation required

Community water reliability

Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu

Regional drought exposure makes reliable water access a priority for investigation. The selected village, affected population and unmet local service gap still need confirmation.

Proposed action

Assess a connected village water system; compare demand management, repairs, source protection and suitable storage or recharge before selecting works.

What is confirmed?

  • Regional screening evidence is identified.
  • Exact site and local baseline are pending.
  • No appointed partner, maintenance owner or committed funding.

Next action: Select an actual village cluster and confirm permission to establish a local baseline.

D02 / HEATConcept · Field validation required

Heat-resilient institutions

Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu

Published urban heat-risk mapping provides a basis for investigating exposed institutions. No school, health facility or workplace has been selected or thermally assessed.

Proposed action

Measure exposure during occupied hours, audit buildings and compare appropriate shading, ventilation and roof improvements with institutional preparedness.

What is confirmed?

  • Regional screening evidence is identified.
  • Exact site and local baseline are pending.
  • No appointed partner, maintenance owner or committed funding.

Next action: Identify candidate institutions using the heat-risk maps and obtain permission for thermal monitoring.

D03 / AGRICULTUREConcept · Field validation required

Dryland farm resilience

Anantapur dryland region, Andhra Pradesh

Historical agricultural contingency planning documents delayed rainfall and dry-spell risks. Current administrative boundaries, farms, crop conditions and gaps in existing support need verification.

Proposed action

Work with a comparable farmer group to assess crop-stage risks, trial locally validated soil-water and crop-contingency measures, and monitor production stability and net income.

What is confirmed?

  • Regional screening evidence is identified.
  • Exact site and local baseline are pending.
  • No appointed partner, maintenance owner or committed funding.

Next action: Select the current mandal and farmer cluster, reconcile historical boundaries and obtain baseline records.

SOUTH INDIA / SCREENING CONTEXT

Different landscapes need different responses.

These published needs inform future site screening. They are not additional POIGAI projects, partnerships or funding commitments.

GeographyNeed to investigateEvidence starting point
Southern Tamil NaduDrought exposure, seasonal water reliability and rainfed crop risks.MAUSAM regional drought study ↗
Chennai basin, Tamil NaduCatchment water balance and climate-related water risk; identify local gaps alongside existing programmes.TNGCC water-risk assessment programme ↗
Interior KarnatakaTaluk-specific drought planning, water demand and dryland agriculture.Historical taluk drought assessment ↗
Anantapur region, Andhra PradeshDelayed rainfall, dry spells and farm contingency planning.ICAR-CRIDA district contingency plans ↗
Hyderabad / Telangana urban areasHeat exposure and suitable institutional or building cooling.Telangana Cool Roof Policy 2023–2028 ↗
Kuttanad, KeralaMonsoon flooding, seasonal salinity and farm-water management.Kerala Agricultural University landscape evidence ↗
Puducherry / KaraikalCoastal resilience and locally appropriate responses to salinity and dry spells.Government climate action plan ↗

Evidence varies in age and geographic resolution. Historical district boundaries, current hazards, existing investments and local priorities must be checked before site selection.

THE READINESS STANDARD

Seven fields. Evidence before funding review.

Every demonstrator needs an exact location, a measured baseline, a confirmed unmet need, an appointed implementation partner, a named maintenance owner, a costed design and an outcome with an agreed target and deadline.

All seven must be verified, with critical permissions and technical issues resolved, before a dossier is presented as ready for funding review. Passing this gate does not guarantee funding or impact.
